settings.privacy_body_1: Tisura n API tteḥḥeḍent s wudem amaḍan deg iminig-ik (localStorage) ttsendent kan ɣer API n umusnaw n AI — ulac ameskaren ameẓẓyan. Tzeɣreḍ ad tent-tkesteḍ ticki tkesteḍ tasarut tessnekleḍ, neɣ tkesteḍ isefka n usmel n iminig-ik.
settings.privacy_body_2: Asnas-a iḥeḍḍed isefka-ad deg localStorage n iminig-ik: afilay n usqerdec-ik, afilay n tutlayt-ik, afilay n usɣan n tnaṭwit (Web/Native), afilay n unadi n woddo, afilay n usɣan n usemres, amusnaw n AI amatu-ik, tasarut n API n yal amusnaw i tsbeddeḍ, d isefka n usɣan n umiḍan (isɣanen, iḍuṭan, d yimaynutn iggutnen). Ulac isefka nniḍen i yettwahḥan neɣ i yettwaznan.

kofi.title: Tiɣawsiwin n usentem ɣef Ko-fi
about.what_body: Aɣewwaṛ-agi d amaɣnaz n tẓuri n uεdil n ttalɣiwt s ufus. Ma tgeḍ kra, tgeḍ aṭṭas. S umata. Ma lliɣ d ameddukel n uεmel-agi, tessen acḥal n tikkal ara d-naf tigawin n ttalɣiwt n ttalɣiwt. Uriɣ ad uɣeɣ akud n uftu ɣef yiɣallen iqdimen d ineqqisen i uzzu n tigawin tiqurinin seg yiεdalen iẓṛan ɣer deffir.
about.what_wcag: Isefka-agi mgaraden armi d {wcag} (Aswir A d AA).
about.step_1_body: ⴽⵜⴱ ⵎⴰⵢⴷ ⵜⵛⴰⵔⴽⴷ — ⴰⵙⵎ ⵏ ⵓⵙⴱⴷⴷⵉ, ⴰⵏⴰⵡ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵏⴼⵍ, ⵏⵖ ⴰⴼⵙⵙⴰⵢ.
about.step_2_body: Seqed tibewwiqin n Ufella / Wadda deg yal amaynut i usnifel n tazwart n yicewwiqen. Kkes-it adeg awezlan. Sekmed i txilt.
about.step_3_body: Fren tamuɣli i yettmahalen aṭṭas. Tigawin ttwasɣayen s usemres.
about.step_4_body: Rnu tamesdayt n umkan (mld. "Global:") neɣ seqed AI i usneflel n uglam.
about.feature_ai_body: Senteq kra n umagrad n umiḍan s yiwet n teqbaylit tamẓiyt. Tasarut-inek n API, amusnaw-inek n AI — ur tteḥfeḍ ara deg uqeddac.
